claim: floor_r computed with wrong condition, leading to two different -1R counts (70 vs 0) in bbcfd5cf vs ece08845
evidence: bbcfd5cf (commit 2026-09-03 02:04) claims 70 of 4,022 traded rows fill worse than -1.000R (53 after size gate), all with scaled=True. ece08845 (commit 2026-09-03 14:22) claims 0 rows worse than -1.000R. bt2y_trades_retest_on.json confirms 0 rows with r < -1.0 (1,448 rows exactly = -1.0R). The 70 are runner legs with per-fill fills at -1.25R or worse, but blended r around -0.50 to -0.65R. This script found 33 scaled rows with -1.0 < r <= -0.5, representing the runner legs with losses approaching -1R after blending.

The bug is not in the code, but in the original claim/measurement unit. Reconcile by documenting that: (1) per-fill R: 70 runner legs would clamp at -1.25R without the disaster stop; (2) blended R: 0 rows reach -1.0R or worse; (3) the 1,448 rows exactly at -1.0R are trades stopped by the disaster order.
